authority: Single unified EcoMOF-AI App release log. One App version manages the whole platform; each release lists only the modules it changed. Historical module version numbers are preserved verbatim in history (pre-1.0 modular-development era).

provenance.note: v1.0.0 module changes are authored from the integration work in this release; history is regrouped by module from existing per-module impact fields without altering any original version number.

blurb.zh: 数据驱动白盒主客体催化路线筛选（HGCPS + 不确定度）。
blurb.en: Data-driven white-box host-guest catalytic route screening (HGCPS + uncertainty).

blurb.zh: 气体分离 / 容量筛选（ISODB 真实等温线 + IAST 选择性）。
blurb.en: Gas separation / capacity screening (real ISODB isotherms + IAST selectivity).

blurb.zh: 统一 MOF 身份层与跨模块结构 / 气体 / 催化数据打通。
blurb.en: Unified MOF identity layer linking structure / gas / catalysis records.

blurb.zh: 白盒可解释、稳健性验证与字段级溯源。
blurb.en: White-box explainability, robustness validation, and field-level provenance.

blurb.zh: 统一版本、按模块讲能力、收敛的研究报告与交互可视化。
blurb.en: Unified versioning, module-first capabilities, focused reports, interactive visuals.

headline.zh: 呈现层收尾：数字字体统一、当前版本徽章接单一源、3D 描述符散点扩展，并在首页加入气体分离帕累托图。
headline.en: Presentation polish: unified numeral typography, current-version badges wired to one source, expanded 3D descriptor scatter, and a homepage gas-separation Pareto chart.

summary.zh: 纯呈现层维护，不改算法/分数/底层数据：移除旧等宽数字 alias 与 ad-hoc 等宽字体残留，所有数字走 body 字族并用 tabular-nums 对齐；当前 App 版本从 app_release_log 读取；首页 3D 描述符散点扩展到 CoRE/QMOF 采样并增强轴与悬停信息；新增选择性 × 工作容量帕累托图，真实显示气对覆盖度与 IAST/实验/计算构成。
summary.en: Presentation-only maintenance with no algorithm, score, or source-data changes: removed the legacy fixed-width numeral alias and ad-hoc fixed-width residues, kept numerals on the body family with tabular-nums, made the current App version read from app_release_log, expanded the homepage 3D descriptor scatter with CoRE/QMOF sampling plus richer axes/hover, and added a selectivity × working-capacity Pareto chart that honestly shows gas-pair coverage and IAST/experimental/computed composition.

summary.zh: 数字字体统一 + App 版本徽章单一源 + 首页 3D / 帕累托可视化优化。
summary.en: Numeral typography unification + single-source App version badges + homepage 3D / Pareto visualization updates.

changes.zh: 移除全站旧等宽数字 alias 使用，数字、版本号、指标、计数、步骤号与表格数值统一使用 --font-body，并保留 tabular-nums 对齐；化学式继续走 --font-formula。
changes.en: Removed site-wide legacy fixed-width numeral alias usage; numbers, versions, metrics, counts, step labels, and table values use --font-body with tabular-nums, while chemistry formulas remain on --font-formula.

changes.zh: 新增 APP_VERSION / getCurrentAppVersion 单一版本源，当前 App 徽章显示 App v1.0.2；历史 V3.x / 数据集 v2.x 版本按模块历史原样保留。
changes.en: Added APP_VERSION / getCurrentAppVersion as the single version source; current App badges show App v1.0.2 while historical V3.x / dataset v2.x labels remain unchanged in module history.

changes.zh: 首页 MOF 描述符三维分布改用更大的 CoRE/QMOF 确定性采样，补充轴刻度、真实值悬停、金属 / dataGrade 着色切换和孔径点大小图例。
changes.en: The homepage MOF descriptor 3D view now uses a larger deterministic CoRE/QMOF sample with axis ticks, real-value hover, metal / dataGrade color modes, and pore-size point-size legend.

changes.zh: 首页新增气体分离帕累托图，基于 gas_adsorption_records_v2 中同时具备选择性与工作容量的真实点，按气对切换并标注 IAST/实验/计算覆盖。
changes.en: Added a homepage gas-separation Pareto chart from gas_adsorption_records_v2 records that have both selectivity and working capacity, with gas-pair switching and IAST/experimental/computed coverage.

headline.zh: 体验打磨：全站字体统一、修掉旧版本区块、修复首页 3D 散点。
headline.en: Experience polish: site-wide font unification, legacy version block removed, homepage 3D scatter fixed.

summary.zh: 纯呈现层维护，不改算法/分数/数据：统一字体 token，数字归一为同一 sans 字族并 tabular-nums 对齐；衬线仅保留给化学式；移除与 App v1.0.0 矛盾的旧版本区块；修复 3D 描述符散点的切顶、挤团与空白。
summary.en: Presentation-only maintenance with no algorithm/score/data changes: unified font tokens with numbers on one sans family (tabular-nums), serif reserved for chemistry formulas, removal of the legacy version block that conflicted with App v1.0.0, and fixes to the 3D descriptor scatter (clipping, clustering, empty space).

summary.zh: 字体统一 + 版本区块修复 + 3D 散点修复。
summary.en: Font unification + version-block fix + 3D scatter fix.

changes.zh: 建立字体 token（--font-body / --font-formula）：所有文本与数字用同一 sans 字族，数字以 tabular-nums 对齐，不再用固定宽度数字字体。
changes.en: Added font tokens (--font-body / --font-formula): all text and numbers share one sans family with tabular-nums; decorative fixed-width numerals removed.

changes.zh: 衬线仅保留给化学式 / 数学公式；清除散落的旧式 sans 与 ad-hoc 固定宽度字体。
changes.en: Serif reserved for chemistry / math formulas only; scattered legacy sans and ad-hoc fixed-width declarations removed.

changes.zh: 移除首页与 App v1.0.0 矛盾的「近期进展 V3.4–V3.6」区块，旧版只在折叠的 pre-1.0 历史中出现。
changes.en: Removed the homepage 'Recent Progress V3.4–V3.6' block that conflicted with App v1.0.0; legacy versions stay in the collapsed pre-1.0 history.

changes.zh: 修复 3D 描述符散点：标题不再切顶，按数据自适应填满视图（不再挤团/留白），新增方向指示器。
changes.en: Fixed the 3D descriptor scatter: title no longer clipped, data auto-fits to fill the view (no clustering/empty space), added an orientation gizmo.

headline.zh: 首个统一平台版本：把有机酸、气体分离、数据库与验证整合到单一 App 版本号下。
headline.en: First unified platform release: organic-acid, gas separation, database, and validation now ship under one App version.

summary.zh: 整合此前各模块为成熟 App 的统一版本；此前为模块化开发期，原始版本号（有机酸 V3.9.x / 数据库 V2.2 / 气体 v2.1 等）见下方历史沿革，一律未改。自 v1.0.0 起，每次发布只列出本次有更新的模块。
summary.en: Integrates the previously separate modules into one mature App version. Earlier work was the modular-development era; original module version numbers (Organic Acid V3.9.x, Database V2.2, Gas v2.1, ...) are preserved unchanged in the history below. From v1.0.0, each release lists only the modules it changed.

summary.zh: 白盒主客体催化路线筛选，八因子加权几何 HGCPS 加不确定度。
summary.en: White-box host-guest route screening with eight-factor weighted-geometric HGCPS plus uncertainty.

changes.zh: HGCPS 八因子加权几何评分方法论作为独立模块呈现。
changes.en: Eight-factor weighted-geometric HGCPS methodology surfaced as a standalone module.

changes.zh: 描述符消融与敏感度分析，标注高优先级实验假设而非最终结论。
changes.en: Descriptor ablation and sensitivity analysis, marked as a high-priority hypothesis, not a final conclusion.

changes.zh: B2 分数引入 Monte-Carlo 不确定度误差条。
changes.en: B2 scores now carry Monte-Carlo uncertainty error bars.

summary.zh: 气体分离与容量筛选，基于真实单组分等温线计算 IAST 选择性。
summary.en: Gas separation and capacity screening with IAST selectivity computed from real pure-component isotherms.

changes.zh: Gas Adsorption v2.1：对成对真实等温线计算 69 个 computed-IAST 选择性值。
changes.en: Gas Adsorption v2.1: 69 computed-IAST selectivity values from paired real isotherms.

changes.zh: 把 79 条气体记录保守链接到 CoRE/QMOF 结构候选。
changes.en: Linked 79 gas records to CoRE/QMOF structure candidates under explicit confidence labels.

changes.zh: 首页新增「进入 GasSep」入口，与其它模块同级。
changes.en: Added a peer-level 'Enter GasSep' entry on the homepage.

changes.zh: GasSep、MOF Library、Data Sources 同步展示真实覆盖度。
changes.en: Coverage surfaced consistently across GasSep, MOF Library, and Data Sources.

summary.zh: 统一 MOF 身份层，把结构、气体与催化记录打通为可浏览的全貌。
summary.en: Unified MOF identity layer linking structure, gas, and catalysis records into one browsable view.

changes.zh: MOF Library 重做为统一 MOF 浏览器：分面检索 + 结构/气体/催化三类完整度 + 详情聚合。
changes.en: MOF Library rebuilt as a unified browser: faceted search + structure/gas/catalysis completeness + aggregated detail panel.

changes.zh: 经 mofIdentity 聚合各来源 provenance，给出覆盖度统计。
changes.en: Provenance aggregated via mofIdentity with coverage statistics.

changes.zh: 保留 CoRE/QMOF 结构导入与 gas 吸附 v2.1 记录层。
changes.en: Preserves CoRE/QMOF structural imports and the gas-adsorption v2.1 record layer.

summary.zh: 白盒可解释加稳健性验证，所有派生量都标注边界。
summary.en: White-box explainability plus robustness validation, with every derived value bounded.

changes.zh: 结构代理与真实 uptake 做 Spearman 指示性审计，低相关标 low-validity-indicative。
changes.en: Structure proxies audited against real uptake via Spearman, low correlations flagged low-validity-indicative.

changes.zh: 新增 provenance 与反防伪测试。
changes.en: Added provenance and anti-fabrication tests.

changes.zh: 保留模型可信度 v2（78.87 / Grade B）与高过拟合风险的诚实披露。
changes.en: Keeps credibility v2 (78.87 / Grade B) and the honest High Overfitting Risk disclosure.

summary.zh: 成熟 App 体验：统一版本、按模块讲能力、收敛的研究报告与交互可视化。
summary.en: Mature App experience: unified versioning, module-first capabilities, focused reports, interactive visuals.

changes.zh: 统一 App 版本号 + 二级（分模块）更新日志，历史散版收进折叠区。
changes.en: Single App version + secondary per-module changelog; legacy versions folded into a collapsed history.

changes.zh: 首页能力区改为按模块讲能力（EcoScreen / MOF Library / Organic Acid / GasSep）。
changes.en: Homepage capabilities restated module-by-module (EcoScreen / MOF Library / Organic Acid / GasSep).

changes.zh: 研究报告收敛为候选/筛选子 tab + 四块紧凑叙事。
changes.en: Research reports converged into candidate/round sub-tabs with a four-block compact narrative.

changes.zh: 首页新增可交互 3D MOF 描述符散点图（移动端降级为 2D）。
changes.en: Added an interactive 3D MOF descriptor scatter on the homepage (2D fallback on mobile).

label.zh: 历史沿革（pre-1.0 模块化开发期）

note.zh: v1.0.0 之前 EcoMOF-AI 按模块分别迭代，原始版本号与真实 commit 绑定，全部原样保留并按模块归类展示。
note.en: Before v1.0.0, EcoMOF-AI iterated module by module. Original version numbers are bound to real commits and are kept verbatim, regrouped here by module.

organicAcid.note: Added evidence-aware organic-acid workflow scaffolding.
Added performance priority mode and priority-impact summaries across scoring traces.
建立目标函数、输入特征、权重、风险惩罚、合理性检查与敏感性分析。
引入交互式 Feature Selection Workflow、Descriptor Importance Ranking、Benchmark Readiness、Model Comparison、Future Accuracy/ROC pending panels、Top Candidate Review 与 Rank Change Simulator。

废弃 Model Validation Lab 与 Model Benchmark Lab，整合为 Algorithm Validation Center；新增 InteractiveScientificFigure、Figure Inspector、字段级溯源与五张真实 SVG mini chart（Descriptor Importance、Feature Coverage、Model Readiness、Candidate Stability、Top Candidate Ranking）。
新增数据验证管线（schema/units/ranges/duplicates/provenance/evidence/comparability）、标准化引擎、Benchmark Eligibility Gate、Data Leakage Check 与 Label Framework，为 Future ML 准备 Benchmark Dataset。
Organic Acid scoring can read reaction performance data through reaction evidence, reaction quality, comparability, and label-confidence weights.
新增 dataLeakageCheckV3、buildBenchmarkSplit（70/15/15 catalyst-group-aware）、accuracyEligibility、rocEligibility、benchmark runner 与 report；硬门控保证 Accuracy / ROC 只在真实标签下显示。
未新增算法/模型；新增 import pipeline（validate/normalize/dedup/provenance）、importCoreMofV2、importQmofV2、importOrganicAcidLiteratureV2、dataset-origin audit 与 dataIngestionSummary。

新增真实 ML 引擎（mlModels.js：Logistic Regression / Decision Tree / Random Forest + 指标）、buildBenchmarkSplitV2（catalyst/experiment/DOI union-find，70/15/15 + external test）、runRealBenchmark、accuracyEligibilityV2、rocEligibilityV2、modelLeaderboard、firstRealBenchmarkReport、experimentalLabelAudit、groundTruthAudit、experimentalLabelDataset、externalTestDataset。
新增真实分析引擎：permutation feature importance、模型可解释性（LR 系数 / DT 决策路径与分裂重要性 / RF 重要性与树共识）、5-/10-fold 交叉验证、稳定性审计、敏感性分析、特征消融、模型可信度评分（0–100，A/B/C/D）、证据置信度、反应证据图、Benchmark Credibility Audit。从“能运行”到“能解释”。

验证模型稳定性：新增 crossValidationRunnerV2（5/10/repeated 5-fold）、bootstrapValidation（100/500/1000）、confidenceIntervalAnalysis（95% CI）、generalizationAudit、modelStabilityAuditV2、repeatedCvRanking（Win Rate / Average Rank / Variance）、calculateModelReliability、calculateModelCredibilityV2、evidenceStrengthScore、labelProvenanceAudit。
Priority Queue 升级为研究任务队列；Confidence Matrix 支持目标产物、证据类型、置信等级过滤；Knowledge Graph 支持候选/矩阵联动高亮。
未改动模型/Benchmark；统计逻辑从组件下沉到 builder/selector，所有派生数字可追溯，缺失字段统一 fallback（不出现 undefined/null/NaN/[object Object]）。
统计逻辑继续下沉到 builders；GasSep 摘要由当前 records 派生，缺失字段统一 fallback。
新增 HGCPS builders：主体 MOF 选择、客体金属选择、主客体互补评分、路线解释、算法追踪、知识图谱与实验路线导出。
HGCPS 统一为 Host Stability * Host Pathway Support * Guest Activity Compensation * Host-Guest Complementarity * Evidence Confidence * Risk Retention Factor；新增 ±20% 敏感性与消融 builders。
新增实验反馈规则 builders、同条件模板 schema/CSV exports、post-experiment reranking preview、activation report exports，并新增 Project Evolution Organic Acid Host-Guest Algorithm Methodology LaTeX 公式模块。

Added organic-acid algorithm-flow builders for nodes, edges, highlighted top/backup/control paths, node inspector models, host/guest/route competition tables, status bar metrics, advanced navigation, and JSON/CSV/Markdown exports.

Added organic-acid stepwise-execution builders for prediction objective, Step 0-Step 6 execution models, navigator, Step Why Panel, dynamic chart models, objective input-output, pathway coverage, descriptor mapping, host ranking, guest ranking, route HGCPS breakdown, validation coverage, mini map, and JSON export.

Added organicAcidScoreProvenance builders: buildHostScoreProvenance, buildGuestScoreProvenance, buildRouteHgcpsScoreProvenance, buildFactorCompressionTrace, buildRouteFactorComparisonModel, buildDynamicWhyNotOtherExplanation, buildScoreSourceTableModel, buildStepWhyPanelEnhancedModel, buildScoreDataGradeBadges, buildTerminologyAlignmentModel.

Added src/utils/organicAcidExplanationClosure builders: buildPathwayEvidenceHeatmapModel, buildDescriptorMappingExplanationModel, buildValidationCoverageMatrixModel, buildPathwayEvidenceSummary, buildDescriptorMappingSummary, buildValidationCoverageSummary, buildTerminologyCrosswalk, buildExplanationClosureExportJson, buildOrganicAcidVisualQaChecklist.

Added organicAcidScoreProvenance builders: buildPerFactorInterpretation, buildFactorDeltaTable, buildFactorEvidence, buildRiskDecomposition, buildCounterfactual, and buildFinalResultSummaryModel; counterfactuals use one-factor-at-a-time white-box HGCPS recomputation, not ML training or inference.

Added buildStructuredConclusion and expanded buildFinalResultSummaryModel with routeComparisonModel, factorOverlayModel, validationDonutModel, chartCaptions, interpretationParagraphs, per-factor details, and evidence mapping. No ML training or inference was introduced.

Adds organicAcidDataDerivation host/guest/route builders, family assignment, min-max normalization, fallback threshold handling, route-factor provenance, and runtime HGCPS recomputation from spec-defined keys.

Uses spec v2 as the sole scoring rule source. Host scoring adds ligandPathwaySupport and synthesizabilityScore; route scoring adds independent synthesizability and economic factors and uses a preregistered weighted geometric mean. The composite pore proxy remains at reduced influence because surface area and void fraction alone showed low reaction validity.

Keeps spec-v2 weights and descriptor definitions unchanged. Adds L0 structure-only, L1 ligand, L2 synthesizability, and L3 economics recomputation plus weight*ln(factor) contribution decomposition. Content-addressed memoization reuses derivations across equivalent cloned datasets while changed inputs still recompute.
No algorithm change in V3.9.9. Algorithm/closure module versions stay V3.9.8; only methodology UI copy, terminology (OACS/DMRS/OAFS -> HGCPS), layout density, and run/status visibility changed.
Adds white-box Langmuir / dual-site Langmuir / Freundlich fitting and binary IAST solving; no ML is introduced and missing pair isotherms remain unavailable.

gasSep.note: Reuses existing CoRE, QMOF, gas adsorption, organic-acid reaction, literature, and gold datasets. No new external records are fabricated; sparse dopant descriptors are explicitly marked as literature priors.
Gas v2.1 keeps 442 gas records, computes 69 IAST selectivity values, and links 79 gas records to structural candidates under explicit confidence labels.

database.note: Manual evidence records enriched.
First source_confirmed / citation_ready candidates.
V2.0-M verification records stayed bounded.
250-record Database Preview with field-level provenance.
Expanded preview from 250 to 1000 candidates.
Centralized database growth history and provenance-backed metrics.
Reports now carry database version, field provenance, citation package, data gaps, and run snapshot.
No database expansion; localization gap report was refreshed.
No database expansion; existing Organic Acid candidate fixtures and evidence records feed the white-box closure layer.
No database expansion; benchmark readiness reads the existing 1000-record preview and Organic Acid bounded fixtures.
No database expansion; the figure reads the existing 1000-record preview summary and Organic Acid bounded fixtures.
新增 Data Source Registry、Unified Import Schema、Organic Acid Gold Dataset V1（50 条真实溯源记录）、Literature Dataset V1（分层）与 Benchmark Dataset V1。
Expanded literature, Gold, reaction, label, verified metadata, and benchmark-ready datasets.

数据规模突破 3000：CoRE 1240 + QMOF 1240 + Literature 540；Verified Metadata 2480、Gold 320、Reaction 520、Benchmark 520。external-database 记录携带真实 CoRE/QMOF 数据集 DOI/citation，描述符值为 database-distribution-attributed（valueBasis），不伪造、非 synthetic fixture。
未扩数据库；新增 experimental_labels_v1.json（40）、experimental_label_audit_v1.json、external_test_dataset_v1.json（36，独立、与训练集不相交）、first_real_benchmark_report_v1.json。
未扩数据库、未新增标签、未修改 V3.4 Benchmark/Ground Truth/Split。新增 model_credibility_report_v1.json、reaction_evidence_graph_v1.json。

新增 experimental_labels_v2.json（150，含 V3.4 的 40 作为子集）、experimental_label_provenance_audit.json（Derived=0 / Synthetic=0）、external_test_dataset_v2.json（80，独立不相交）、benchmark_dataset_v3_6.json（230 eligible，未改动 V3.3 的 benchmark_dataset_v3.json）、model_robustness_report_v1.json。
未新增无来源结果；继续复用 V3.6 experimental labels、benchmark dataset、Organic Acid evidence records 与 demo/proxy/inferred 边界。

未改动底层数据集（保留 V3.6/V3.8 产物）；新增 src/data/registry（dataSourceRegistry/datasetTypes）、src/utils/summary（global database / research reports / version history / current release / export 摘要）、src/utils/fallback（safeNumber/safePercent/normalizeMissingValue/formatDataCardValue）、src/utils/export（csv/json/fileName/sanitize）。
未改动数据集；新增 buildGasSepSummary（含 filter/coverage/distribution/benchmark/export 子构建器）与 buildOrganicAcidSummary（evidence/confidence/matrix/queue/graph/benchmark/export）。
organic_acid_host_guest seed 数据扩展到 10 个 host、12 个 guest、25 条 route、58 条 evidence/risk records，并派生 evidence matrix 与 risk matrix。
新增 public/data/organic_acid_experimental_activation 下 7 个 seed/curated/proxy 数据文件，覆盖具体 Al-MOF 主体、Mo 引入、最小实验矩阵、同条件记录模板、pending 结果模板、反馈规则和启用就绪摘要。
No new experimental result or database expansion; the refactor reuses existing V3.9.2-V3.9.4 Organic Acid host, guest, route, evidence-risk, validation, activation, and methodology data.

No new experimental result or database expansion; the release reuses existing Organic Acid pathway, descriptor, host, guest, route, evidence-risk, validation, activation, and methodology data while exposing them through stepwise builder outputs.
No new experimental result or database expansion; reuses existing host / guest / route / scoreBreakdown / provenance data and exposes it through score provenance builders.

No new experimental result or database expansion; reuses pathwaySteps / descriptorMap / evidenceRiskRecords / validationExperiments / activation data and exposes them through explanation-closure builders.
No new experimental result or database expansion; reuses existing pathwaySteps, descriptorMap, host/guest/route candidates, evidenceRiskRecords, validationExperiments, and activation data.

No database expansion and no new experimental result. Reuses existing host/guest/route, evidence-risk, validation, and activation data through score-provenance builders, including organic_acid_experimental_activation planning sources.

Reuses existing CoRE, QMOF, gas adsorption, organic-acid reaction, literature, and gold datasets. No new external records are fabricated; sparse dopant descriptors are explicitly marked as literature priors.

Adds a curated linker descriptor table covering all ten linker labels present in the current CoRE import, a transparent placeholder metal-precursor cost table with per-row TODO verification labels, an audit artifact, and a reproducible V3.9.7 rerun artifact.

source_confirmed / citation_ready / near_verified did not equal verified_metadata.
Real-label metrics were withheld.
Verified metadata increased from 0 to 30.
Project validation history moved to a dedicated evolution workspace.
Validation status, verified metadata count, and not-final-recommendation boundary are embedded in reports.
增加 sanity check 与 sensitivity analysis，但仍需实验反馈验证。

建立 Gold / Silver / Bronze / Rejected 数据分层；真实实验标签仍不足，Label Count = 0，Accuracy / ROC-AUC 继续 Pending。
